fragment.description: Readers Tenants Civic Workers and Threats for Hidden Courts, Monster Districts, Municipal Magic Conspiracy. Three original city campaigns: readers detained by hidden courts, nocturnal homes facing a daylight inspection and streets erased by a private spell contract.

description.value: Librarian Mara Leaf: knows which borrower took the ending and refuses to surrender readers' memories.
Tenant Kai Lantern: can repair the blackout circuit if the roof is opened.
Dispatcher Ren Route: keeps callers' descriptions of streets the map no longer admits exist.
Court Reader Tessa Margin: will release patrons if the lending record proves her claim expired.
Caretaker Ivo Shade: hid the inspection notice to protect neighbors and now needs their help.
Clerk Bea Permit: copied the unauthorized contract before its index vanished.
Borrower Neri Tomorrow: has the final page but cannot find the return chute's present entrance.
Inspector Sol Night: can accept a witnessed evening inspection if safety conditions are documented.
Archivist Fia Street: keeps an offline address list in the utility basement.
Student Juno Ink: remembers the treaty's final sentence without knowing its meaning.
Cook Mei Common: can gather neighbors who usually avoid each other's shifts.
Engineer Oren Grid: can restore names if the private extension's feed is isolated.
Court Herald Dev Index: admits the ending was lent without both courts' consent.
Courier Noa Roof: can carry repair cells through the tower's daylight landing.
Paramedic Rosa Turn: needs a usable route to the unnamed junction before another call.
Pagebinder Ada Spine: can rejoin the treaty without erasing the borrower's annotation.
Neighbor Pell Dawn: wants safe stairs and will oppose the forced sweep if repairs are visible.
Auditor Ash Budget: found payments for streets that disappeared after contract renewal.
Reader Len Memory: lost a childhood recollection while trying to leave the margin room.
Witness Kira Shift: can document a safe inspection without disclosing private identities.
Resident Taro Unbound: knows the old street name and wants residents to choose its return.
Deskkeeper Siva Due: will move the return deadline if both courts sign the repair.
Shadeworker Tess Wire: can bypass the broken circuit at a visible fire risk.
Organizer Eri Map: collects residents' route choices before the spell office reconnects them.
Margin Bailiff: takes memories as exit payment unless the treaty ending is restored.
Daylight Sweep Crew: forces doors open at dawn despite a safer inspection proposal.
Street Eraser: enforces a private spell extension over public emergency routes.
Index Moth: eats the return record and retreats from a complete spoken sentence.
Shade Saboteur: cuts roof access to profit from the tower's inspection failure.
Permit Enforcer: seizes the offline list as an unauthorized map.
Tomorrow Librarian: keeps the page beyond closing until its true due date is shown.
Sunlit Sentinel: guards the stairs without distinguishing residents from threats.
Route Doppelganger: sends rescuers to a duplicate junction absent from the paper map.
Court Usurer: offers a replacement ending at the cost of permanent reader tribute.
False Caretaker: offers a shade repair that locks all tenants inside.
Budget Wraith: conceals the spell extension's payment trail in repeating invoices.
Borrowed Memory Shade: imitates the lost recollection to lure a reader from witnesses.
Roof Lock Automaton: rejects valid tenant access while obeying an outdated inspection hold.
Archive Shredder: destroys streets removed from the private index.
Closing Bell Echo: repeats the library's detention rule after the treaty is whole.
Inspection Rumor: turns ordinary neighbors against nocturnal households with false safety claims.
Contract Reflection: recreates the erased street feed unless the extension is explicitly ended.
